name: s3
summary: Store product images and other media in an S3-compatible bucket (AWS S3, R2, MinIO).

env.name: S3_BUCKET
env.comment: The bucket media is stored in; it must already serve its objects publicly

env.name: S3_ENDPOINT
env.comment: An S3-compatible API (MinIO, R2); leave unset for AWS

env.name: S3_PUBLIC_URL
env.comment: Where the bucket's objects are served from (a CDN); defaults to the bucket's own URL

env.name: NYMBAL_S3_PREFIX
env.comment: Starts every object key; none by default

env.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.comment: Credentials for the AWS SDK; a profile or a role works instead

next: Create the bucket and let it serve its objects publicly: the store never creates buckets or sets policies.
Give the AWS SDK credentials: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY in .env, a profile or a role.
